select ic.relname as name, am.amname as method, (i.indpred is not null) as partial, a.attname::text as column,
      pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid, k.ord::int, true) as definition, oc.opcname::text as opclass
    from pg_index i
    join pg_class ic on ic.oid = i.indexrelid
    join pg_am am on am.oid = ic.relam
    cross join lateral unnest(i.indkey::int2[], i.indclass::oid[]) with ordinality k(attnum, opclass, ord)
    left join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = i.indrelid and a.attnum = k.attnum and k.attnum > 0
    join pg_opclass oc on oc.oid = k.opclass
    where i.indrelid = to_regclass($1) and i.indisvalid and i.indisready and k.ord <= i.indnkeyatts
    order by ic.relname, k.ord

with g as (
      select case when grouping("k0") = 0 then 0 end as s, "k0", count(*) as n
      from ((select "t"."status" as "k0" from "companies" as "t" where "t"."deleted_at" is null and "t"."organization_id" = $1 and ("t"."revenue" < $2) offset $3)) as v
      group by grouping sets (("k0"))
    ), r as (
      select g.*, row_number() over (partition by s order by n desc, "k0") as rank from g
    )
    select s, "k0", n::text as n from r
    where s not in (0) or rank <= $4
    order by s, rank

with g as (
      select case when grouping("k0") = 0 then 0 when grouping("k1") = 0 then 1 when grouping("k2") = 0 then 2 end as s, "k0", "k1", "k2", count(*) as n
      from ((select "t"."organization_id" as "k0", case when "t"."revenue" is not null then least(width_bucket("t"."revenue"::float8, $1::float8, $2::float8, $3::int), $4::int) end as "k1", case when "t"."created_at" >= $5::timestamptz and "t"."created_at" < $6::timestamptz then to_char(date_trunc('day', ("t"."created_at"::timestamptz at time zone $7::text)), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') end as "k2" from "companies" as "t" where "t"."deleted_at" is null and "t"."organization_id" = $8 and ("t"."status" = $9 and "t"."revenue" < $10) offset $11)) as v
      group by grouping sets (("k0"), ("k1"), ("k2"))
    ), r as (
      select g.*, row_number() over (partition by s order by n desc, "k0", "k1", "k2") as rank from g
    )
    select s, "k0", "k1", "k2", n::text as n from r
    where s not in (0) or rank <= $12
    order by s, rank

with b as (
      select generate_series(date_trunc('day', ($1::timestamptz at time zone $2::text)), date_trunc('day', ($3::timestamptz at time zone $4::text) - interval '1 microsecond'), '1 day'::interval) as bucket
    ), c as ((select date_trunc('day', ("t"."created_at"::timestamptz at time zone $5::text)) as "bucket", count(*)::text as "n" from "companies" as "t" where "t"."deleted_at" is null and "t"."organization_id" = $6 and ("t"."status" = $7 and "t"."revenue" < $8) and "t"."created_at" >= $9::timestamptz and "t"."created_at" < $10::timestamptz group by 1))
    select to_char(b.bucket, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') as bucket, coalesce(c.n, '0') as n
    from b left join c on c.bucket = b.bucket
    order by b.bucket
